definition: A corporation's annual income tax return reporting total receipts, cost of goods sold, deductions, taxable income, tax liability, credits, and payments for a tax year.

includes.text: Form reports gross receipts or sales with returns and allowances, cost of goods sold, and various deductions including compensation of officers, salaries and wages, depreciation, and pension contributions.
includes.quote: Gross receipts or sales. Enter on line 1a gross

includes.text: Form includes calculation of taxable income before and after net operating loss deduction, followed by tax computation with credits and estimated tax payments.
Form contains balance sheet information and reconciliation schedules for book income versus tax return income.

excludes.text: S corporation return allocates income to shareholders through separate statements rather than computing corporate-level tax.
Schedule for reporting sales and dispositions of capital assets separately from ordinary business income and deductions.
excludes.quote: Sales and Other Dispositions of Capital Assets

discriminators.text: This form computes tax at the corporate entity level; the sibling allocates all income and deductions to shareholders with no entity-level tax.
discriminators.quote: Income tax. Multiply taxable income (page 1, line 30)

discriminators.text: This form reports ordinary business income, expenses, and gains; the sibling is limited to reporting only capital asset sales and dispositions.
This form reports the corporation's own taxable income and tax liability; the sibling reports one partner's allocated share of partnership income.
